> MattOf course there is a card. If you play with some big boys with titles,
princes and justicars to be precise, you can use 4th Tradition
(uncommon).

Cost: 1 Blood
Effect: Put 3 blood on a younger, uncontrolled Vampire...

Another solution is: Use Ebanezer Roush in your Deck. With some melee
weapon or shere potence he will make short work of mini-vampires.
Then your enemies have a lot of vampires in torpor or burned.

A staple card in my nosferatu crypt is Nickolaus Vermeulen. Prince,
capacity 7. Once each untap phase, you may move one blood from
Nikolaus to any uncontrolled Nosferatu. I always try to get him out
first and use him to get other vamps out quicker early in the game,
and to make pool later in the game. Get a blood doll on him, and any
of the blood gain cards such as aaron's feeding razor, palatial
estate, etc... and he's a pool making machine. Not to mention two
votes, POT, for, obf, ani. No matter your strategy for Nos you can
make him a centerpiece.
